Profile Vaccines containing RSV protein subunit are being studied for active immunisation. ◊ Development of an effective and safe vaccine against RSV has been hampered by a number of factors.1-3 The target population for a vaccine is mainly young infants who may not respond ade- quately to vaccination owing to the antigenic diversity of RSV, immunological immaturity, or the presence of maternal antibod- ies.
